subject: Re: Cell Mixer kickoff — ground-truth scRNA-seq benchmarks
body:
Viktor,

Resourcing: Csilla and Ondrej carry the R/Bioconductor stack (Seurat, scran, DropletUtils — the cell_mixer.R path), both at 40%. Rosa (50%) owns fetch_data.sh hardening and the anndata export so Python consumers aren't forced through R. Wanjiru (30%) does the Evalline hookup in July.

Compute: negligible, CPU batch jobs. The one infra dependency is storage + Corpus. Raw 10X downloads are ~40GB and only need fetching once; mixtures live in Corpus. The Corpus v2 migration freeze lands 2026-08-07, so we have until early August to move the 10X-derived mixture tables over — comfortable margin after the July release.

Only wrinkle: loomR install is flaky on the shared image (devtools from GitHub, develop branch). Ondrej will bake a container so nobody loses a day to it.

Bruno
